claims.hypothesis: A kpc-scale ordered B-field exists in 9io9 at z=2.6
claims.experiment: Polarized 242 GHz continuum plus lensed source-plane simulations
claims.result: chi_B = 5 (+5/-10) deg, parallel to the CO disk; P ~0.6%
claims.finding: A 5 kpc-scale ordered field aligned with the disk is present

evidence.quote: This result implies the presence of a 5 kpc-scale galactic ordered magnetic field orientated parallel to the molecular gas-rich disk.

claims.hypothesis: The mean-field dynamo has had time to order the field
claims.experiment: Ordering timescale and dynamo number estimate
claims.finding: Mean-field dynamo has not yet had time to amplify; starburst turbulence dominant
